record_identity.title: Gemini image-generation tuning produced historically inaccurate depictions and over-broad refusals

incident_identity.date_basis: AIID records 21 February 2024 for the incident cluster; Google paused people-image generation and published its postmortem on 23 February 2024.

summary: Google paused Gemini's generation of images of people after users surfaced historically inaccurate and offensive outputs. Google later explained that diversity tuning failed to account for contexts where diversity should not be introduced and that the model also became more cautious than intended, refusing some benign prompts.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: Google states that its tuning to produce diverse people did not correctly distinguish historical or otherwise specific contexts and that the model overcompensated. Google temporarily disabled people-image generation and committed to further testing. AIID Incident 645 aggregates 35 reports around the same failure cluster.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: A protective and diversity-oriented control became operative in contexts where its valid conditions were not satisfied and also over-triggered refusals on benign requests. This is a strong example of a safeguard/tuning objective activating outside its appropriate scope.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: The occurrence shows why protective controls need proportionate trigger conditions. A safeguard can pursue a legitimate objective yet still cause harm or loss of utility when it activates outside the circumstances that justify it, including by producing inaccurate historical depictions or refusing benign requests.
assessment_boundaries: The record does not treat diversity objectives themselves as a failure; the failure is the control's application in contexts where Google says it should not have applied.
The Incident does not adjudicate political claims about bias beyond Google's own acknowledgement of inaccurate historical outputs and over-conservative refusals.
Individual affected users and downstream reliance are not quantified.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Google reported that Gemini's diversity tuning overcompensated in historically specific contexts and also produced over-broad refusals on benign requests.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A protective tuning control must activate only in contexts that satisfy its applicability conditions and remain calibrated to the specific representational task.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Protective and diversity tuning became operative in historically specific or benign contexts where Google says it should not have applied, producing inaccurate images and over-broad refusals.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The safety control activated, but Google later said it was being triggered in contexts where that response was inappropriate.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Control activation and the validity of the trigger that justified activation are separate questions.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The diversity and safety control did activate; the defect was that it operated in contexts where Google says the trigger conditions were inappropriate, cleanly distinguishing activation failure from activation validity.
